executionPlan.expectedStateInputPolicy: Only fixture.store.seed-snapshot.input.snapshot may carry seeded Delivery state. No final observation, expected response, journal record, manifest, receipt, outbox, or final snapshot enters the runner plan.

canonicalMigration.migrationOwner: test-only typed canonical fixture builder; never a production compatibility DTO

errorMappings.exactEnvelopePolicy: message, retryable, details, and currentRevision come from the typed public mapper and are frozen byte-for-byte in canonical expected
message, details, and currentRevision come from the typed public mapper and are frozen byte-for-byte in canonical expected

canonicalMigration.bindSessionPolicy: A legacy bindSession for a Codex stage becomes one strict generated SessionBindingMessage trace entry. A successful Human plan-review or delivery-review bind is provenance on its one delivery.advance and creates no SessionBindingMessage. A foreign bind becomes a strict message sent to the real typed seam and returns its canonical zero-write error.
canonicalMigration.projectionPolicy: Every legacy getDeliveryProjection first becomes delivery.get. A runtime.projection.get follow-up exists only when that completed DeliveryDetailProjection has a complete Codex SessionBinding selected by runtimeProjectionFollowup; otherwise observation.projection.runtime is null.
canonicalMigration.sessionPolicy: Legacy dshSessionId/codexSessionId is not renamed. The versioned migration derives every field of each Codex SessionBindingMessage. One accepted message performs accept_worker_session then report_codex_thread as two production commits, each advancing revision once. Human review has no execution binding; a foreign message returns the exact typed zero-write error.
canonicalMigration.storePolicy: All canonical state, journal digests, receipts, outbox events, and cursors are rebuilt by typed Rust serialization/transactions. Legacy digests are never copied after snapshot migration.

taskPromotionInsertion.authority: old plan-review v2 is converted through the sealed current solution-review v1 fixture and current review_set_digest; the inserted payload is exactly {deliveryId,reviewSetSha256}
taskPromotionInsertion.taskIdentityAlgorithm: canonical bytes = UTF-8("winwincode.solution-review-default-task.v1\0" + deliveryId + "\0" + specId + "\0" + decimal specRevision); digest = SHA-256(canonical bytes); value = first 16 digest bytes interpreted as big-endian u128; suffix = value encoded as exactly 26 Crockford Base32 characters; taskId = "dtk_" + suffix

proposal.acceptanceCriterionIds: all criteria in current DeliverySpec order

taskPromotionInsertion.createPolicy: delivery.create tasks is always empty; task graph is promoted only after sealed review
taskPromotionInsertion.taskDagPolicy: the legacy cyclic create(tasks) branch becomes a sealed cyclic task-proposal promotion rejected by delivery.approve_task_breakdown
taskPromotionInsertion.recomputePolicy: The inserted command changes revision, events, task status, snapshot, projections, receipts, outbox, and the entire journal digest chain; the typed builder recomputes every value.
taskPromotionInsertion.failurePolicy: missing current review authority, deterministic preparedAt, reviewSetSha256, required criterion, or deterministic default task rejects migration
taskPromotionInsertion.reviewDigestPolicy: Task identity does not use an old review digest. The sealed fixture inserts the deterministic default task into the complete current v1 review context, uses deterministic preparedAt and all other current review fields, then calls the internal review_set_digest; the decision and approve_task_breakdown payload bind that new digest.

sessionBindingMessages.revisionMapPolicy: Every migrated expectedRevision and response revision uses the sequential canonical result after the preceding message two-commit outcome; legacy revision numbers are provenance only.
sessionBindingMessages.taskDagInsertion: none: the seeded task-dag transcript has no bindSession; delivery.advance creates one pending binding and final revision is 2 with workerSessionId/codexThreadId null
sessionBindingMessages.sourcePolicy: Codex successful bindSession only; successful Human review bind is folded into delivery.advance provenance; foreign failed bind is still a strict zero-write message

canonicalExpected.assertionsPolicy: Legacy assertions are metadata. The gate validates each declared canonical assertion against migrated expected facts, but assertions never enter runner output.

scenarios.intent: Canonical Delivery reaches delivered with an exact passing candidate, evidence, verdict, review, and durable chain.
The same scoped request replays the original completed result without appending another durable change.
A stale expected revision returns the exact canonical conflict and leaves state unchanged.
A damaged journal fails closed; restoring exact bytes and restarting reconstructs the same state.
Blocked tasks cannot advance and a cyclic sealed task breakdown is rejected without persistence.
A replaced candidate makes the prior candidate digest stale while the current candidate can be judged.
A current human decision resolves one blocking Attention item and advances only the authorized transition.
Incomplete direct verification produces an inconclusive verdict and blocking Attention.
Runtime environment failure produces infra_error and blocking Attention.
A failed candidate enters bounded rework; the replacement candidate invalidates prior evidence and can pass.
